title: Uma manhã no café
grammar: Perguntas com was/were + -ing e respostas curtas
goal: Pergunte com Was/Were + sujeito + -ing e responda com Yes, I was ou No, I wasn’t.
reading: Tina was working at the café on Friday morning.
Tina estava trabalhando no café na sexta de manhã.
A customer was waiting at the counter for a big order.
Um cliente esperava no balcão por um pedido grande.
Tina was making coffee, but the machine was making a strange noise.
Tina fazia café, mas a máquina fazia um barulho estranho.
Her friend Lou was watching from a table.
A amiga Lou olhava de uma mesa.
They were laughing when the customer finally got his order.
Elas riam quando o cliente finalmente recebeu o pedido.
dialogue: Was the café busy on Friday?
O café estava movimentado na sexta?
Yes, it was. Many people were waiting.
No, I wasn’t. Lou was helping me.
Não. A Lou estava me ajudando.
No, he wasn’t. He was smiling.
Você estava fazendo o café dele?
Yes, I was. I was making it slowly.
pron: Em perguntas de sim ou não, como Were you working?, a voz sobe no fim.
gram: Com you, use were, mesmo no singular.
